store_metadata.fastlane/metadata/en-GB/description.txt:
Collect helps Rwanda savings groups organize member records and review whole-RWF MoMo contribution activity.

On iOS, members can inspect group activity and use account and privacy controls. Private-group creation, the app’s MTN MoMo or Airtel Money USSD handoff, and consented receipt-SMS intake require an eligible Android build; these actions are not available in the iOS app.

A pending request or receipt SMS is not a confirmed contribution. Production confirmation requires independently reconciled settlement evidence or an explicitly approved constrained finality policy.

Collect never asks for a MoMo PIN or payment provider OTP. Your WhatsApp sign-in code is used only to sign in to Collect. Collect is a technology and record-keeping service, not a bank or wallet, and does not hold customer funds or provide loans or insurance.

For support, email info@ikanisa.com. In the app, request eligible data deletion through Settings → Security → Delete data. Collect is operated by IKANISA for Rwanda group-contribution workflows.
store_metadata.fastlane/metadata/en-GB/promotional_text: Review Rwanda MoMo group-contribution records and member activity, with clear account and privacy controls.
store_metadata.fastlane/metadata/en-GB/review_notes.txt:
A real review account and supported Sign-In Information must be supplied separately for the artifact under review; no reviewer credentials or authentication bypass are embedded in the app. Sign-in uses a verified Rwanda WhatsApp number.

Use synthetic review data and do not send real funds. iOS supports group records, activity and account controls. Private-group creation, Collect’s MoMo USSD handoff and receipt-SMS intake require eligible Android builds and are unavailable on iOS. No SEPA, bank-transfer or Revolut handoff is implemented. Pending requests and receipt SMS are not independent settlement proof; production confirmation requires governed finality and reconciliation acceptance.

In the app, eligible data deletion is requested through Settings → Security → Delete data. Support: info@ikanisa.com. These source notes do not prove hosted review-account access, provider UAT, artifact approval or App Store readiness.
store_metadata.fastlane/metadata/en-GB/release_notes.tx: Rwanda MoMo group-contribution records, member activity and account/privacy controls. Android-only group creation, USSD handoff and receipt-SMS intake are unavailable on iOS. No bank-transfer journey is included.
store_metadata.fastlane/metadata/android/en-US/full_des:
Collect helps Rwanda groups organize members and review whole-RWF MoMo contribution records. It is a technology and record-keeping service.

Private-group creation is available only on eligible Android builds, after SMS consent and device verification. iOS and web do not create private groups.

Eligible Android members check the exact MTN MoMo or Airtel Money receiver and whole-RWF amount, then approve payment in the mobile network’s USSD prompt. Collect never asks for a MoMo PIN or payment provider OTP and does not hold customer funds. Your WhatsApp sign-in code is only for signing in to Collect.

Eligible Android receiver devices may explicitly consent to newly arriving MoMo receipt SMS as candidate evidence. Collect does not read SMS history, send SMS or access Call Logs. SMS access can be turned off. A pending request or receipt SMS is not a confirmed contribution. Production confirmation requires independently reconciled settlement evidence or an explicitly approved constrained finality policy.

For a Collect question, email info@ikanisa.com. In the app, use Settings → Security → Delete data to request eligible data deletion. Collect does not provide loans, insurance or deposit custody.
